items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: his old lady was Goldie, and Goldie was a fine Creole woman, and Simon wanted to go back to Goldie.

ctx.x: So Paul said, "That's McKinney of McKinney's Cotton Pickers. He wants you to join the band. It would be a great thing for you to join." He said, "I don't know if I want to go to Detroit." See, his old lady was Goldie, and Goldie was a fine Creole woman, and Simon wanted to go back to Goldie. So to keep him from going back, they sent for Goldie to keep him up there. They were interested in trying to help(?) him. So he stayed.
